description: This file contains JavaScript functions for creating and managing project templates, including form validation, dialog confirmation, and UI interactions within the SuiteCRM module 'AM_ProjectTemplates'.

methods.name: checkLength
methods.description: Validates that the length of a form input is within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: checkRegexp
methods.description: Validates that a form input matches a given regular expression.

methods.name: updateTips
methods.description: Displays validation tips or error messages to the user.

methods.name: confirmation
methods.description: Creates a jQuery UI dialog for project creation confirmation, handling form submission and UI updates.
